activity.notes: Jørgen Jørgensen removed Danish authority in Iceland on 26 June 1809, declared Iceland free of Danish rule, and later styled himself Protector with supreme authority. The short-lived revolutionary government exercised actual administrative and coercive authority until British intervention restored Danish government on 22 August 1809, so ATLAS treats it as a distinct revolutionary polity rather than Denmark or a mere event label.

sources.citation_text: The University of Iceland describes the 1809 revolution and surviving correspondence to the Protector of Iceland, including the finances of the revolutionary government.

sources.title: Den islandske revolution 1809 — Danmarkshistorien
sources.citation_text: The Danish historical reference describes the summer 1809 revolution as a brief separation of Iceland from Danish rule under Jørgen Jürgensen.
